worldcombat.skill.disable.summary: Disables the target’s last move. For ordinary creatures and players, it disables the last successful attack method, such as melee or arrows; a different method remains usable.
worldcombat.skill.disable.use.0: Shut off a foe's main damage move
worldcombat.skill.disable.use.1: Break a strong move the foe just revealed
worldcombat.skill.disable.use.2: Force a foe to switch moves and break its combo
worldcombat.skill.disable.description.0: The pin lasts %1$s and prevents the named move. For ordinary targets, hits using the recorded melee, arrow or other attack type are blocked. Milk or effect removal clears the pin.
worldcombat.skill.disable.description.1: Reads back attacks used within %1$s (older ones are lost); the nail reaches %2$s blocks. If the target switched attack before the cast, the current one is named and only that attack is sealed.
worldcombat.skill.disable.description.2: Wind-up %1$s, recovery %2$s, cooldown %3$s. The target can keep fighting with a move outside the list.
worldcombat.skill.disable.heavy.0: Heavy nail: duration x1.3, range x0.9, cooldown x1.15 — holds longer but reaches shorter and costs more.
worldcombat.skill.disable.heavy.1: Light nail: duration x0.8, range x1.1, cooldown x0.85 — reaches farther and is cheaper, but loosens quickly.
worldcombat.skill.disable.timing: Cast on a single enemy: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s, the cooldown %5$s from commit, and the current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.disable.preference.hea: On: duration x1.3, cooldown x1.15, but range x0.9. Off: duration x0.8, cooldown x0.85, range x1.1. Trade how long it holds for how far it reaches.
The partner only considers disabling while a target is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger chases out to pin.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to disable.
